candidates.change_summary: Replace call to withdraw(address(this).balance) with withdraw(address(this).balance - 1) so withdrawAll sends one wei less.
Call withdraw with zero value instead of full balance so withdrawAll transfers nothing.
Change onlyOwner modifier to require msg.sender != owner, inverting access control so withdrawAll cannot be called by the original owner but can by others.
Replace transfer to sender with sending to owner, so withdraw sends funds to owner instead of msg.sender.
Relax onlyOwner to allow any caller (remove requirement), so withdraw can be invoked by non-owners and funds go to msg.sender.
Change the low-level call to use a direct transfer to msg.sender, making sendMoney send funds to the caller rather than the specified _target and potentially revert on failure.
Change the low-level call to ignore the returned success (remove the require), so failures do not revert and sendMoney may silently fail to transfer funds to _target.
Relax onlyOwner modifier to allow any caller by removing the require check, so sendMoney becomes callable by non-owners and can change observable behavior.
